note.es: corrida 07:47 UTC = franja pre-london, pero hoy es sabado CT y ese slot solo vigila lun-vie, asi que no habia corrida del Session Analyst que rehacer; mercado cerrado desde el cierre del viernes hasta la reapertura del domingo 17:00 CT (cierre semanal de Globex), por eso snapshot a 632 min, fuentes/orb/command a 646 min, webhook a 646 min y news a 662 min solo reflejan el cierre, no una falla (orb no frozen: fecha y PDH/PDL de los 5 simbolos coinciden con command); SA pre-asia del viernes sigue en pie (commit 'sa pre-asia 2026-10-10' a las 21:34Z, +29 min vs cron 21:05Z, ok:true); reach ok en los 5 instrumentos (todos TACTICAL, ratio <= 0.26, sin zona inalcanzable); el journal digest sigue parado en 2026-10-05 (109 h), siguen faltando martes 10-06, miercoles 10-07, jueves 10-08 y viernes 10-09 -- unico motivo real del warn
note.en: 07:47 UTC run = the pre-london slot, but today is Saturday CT and that slot only watches Mon-Fri, so there was no Session Analyst run to redo; market closed since Friday's close until the Sunday 17:00 CT reopen (Globex weekly close), so the 632-min snapshot, 646-min sources/orb/command, 646-min webhook and 662-min news only reflect that closure, not a failure (orb not frozen: date and PDH/PDL for all 5 symbols match command); Friday's SA pre-asia run still holds (commit 'sa pre-asia 2026-10-10' at 21:34Z, +29 min vs the 21:05Z cron, ok:true); reach is ok across all 5 instruments (all TACTICAL, ratio <= 0.26, no unreachable zone); the journal digest is still stuck at 2026-10-05 (109 h), still missing Tuesday 10-06, Wednesday 10-07, Thursday 10-08 and Friday 10-09 -- the only real reason for the warn
